proposals.before: His grandfather Tong had served the Northern Wei as Director of the Palace Library and Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry.
proposals.after: His grandfather Tong had served the Northern Wei as a supernumerary cavalier attendant-in-ordinary.
proposals.reason: 通直散騎常侍 is one cavalier-attendant office with the 通直 rank prefix, not the palace library plus a separate attendant post.

proposals.before: He was summoned to an audience at the Xuanwu Gate and spoke of his whole life. The Emperor teased him, saying, "Do you call yourself a flatterer or a straight speaker?
proposals.after: He was summoned to an audience at the Xuanwu Gate and spoke of his whole life. The Emperor teased him, saying, "Do you call yourself a flatterer or a straight speaker?"
proposals.reason: The literal English quotation is missing its closing quotation mark.

proposals.before: The Emperor entered the banner gate and exclaimed to those beside him, "Today's hunt—was it enjoyable?
proposals.after: The Emperor entered the banner gate and exclaimed to those beside him, "Today's hunt—was it enjoyable?"
proposals.reason: The literal English quotation is unclosed.

proposals.before: Attending a banquet in the Poxiang Hall, when the wine was warm, he advanced and said, "Was this built by Emperor Yang?
proposals.after: Attending a banquet in the Poxiang Hall, when the wine was warm, he advanced and said, "Was this built by Emperor Yang?"
proposals.reason: The literal English quotation is unclosed.

proposals.before: How carved and splendid to this degree!
proposals.after: How carved and splendid to this degree!"
proposals.reason: The literal English drops the closing quotation that ends 何雕麗底此.

proposals.before: While he was in Shanzhou, he could not stop crime in the district. He took the blame on himself and publicly flogged himself in the marketplace. The ward chiefs, disgusted by the show, whipped him until he bled. Unable to endure the pain, he cried out and fled; onlookers laughed at his insincerity.
proposals.after: While he was in Shanzhou, he could not stop crime in the district. He took the blame on himself and publicly flogged himself in the marketplace. The lictors, disgusted by the show, whipped him until he bled. Unable to endure the pain, he cried out and fled; onlookers laughed at his insincerity.
proposals.reason: Repair replaces the complete idiomatic sentence; 五伯 in this beating scene are lictors, not ward chiefs.

proposals.before: Liangsi said, "Gongyi Xiu, a single feudal lord's chancellor, uprooted melons and removed weaving—one has not heard of a Son of Heaven selling fruits and vegetables to contend for profit with the people.
proposals.after: Liangsi said, "Gongyi Xiu, a single feudal lord's chancellor, uprooted melons and removed weaving—one has not heard of a Son of Heaven selling fruits and vegetables to contend for profit with the people."
proposals.reason: The literal English quotation is unclosed.

proposals.before: Empress Wu heard of it and warned him, saying, "Just go in and out by the north gate. Those southern-office chancellors come and go—do not offend them.
proposals.after: Empress Wu heard of it and warned him, saying, "Just go in and out by the north gate. Those southern-office chancellors come and go—do not offend them."
proposals.reason: The literal English quotation is unclosed.

proposals.before: An edict directed all officials to attend his funeral rites. He was posthumously honored as grand master of splendid happiness with the golden seal and as regional commander of Yizhou.
proposals.after: An edict directed all officials to attend his funeral rites. He was posthumously honored as kaifu yitong sansi (ceremonial equal of the three palatines) and as regional commander of Yizhou.
proposals.reason: 開府儀同三司 is not the golden-seal splendid-happiness grand-master title (金紫光祿大夫).

proposals.before: In the first year of Shenlong, the post of Minister of Works was restored in gift; Jianyan's son Wuyuan inherited the title and ended as Chief Administrator of the Bin King's Household.
proposals.after: In the first year of Shenlong, the post of Minister of Works was restored as a posthumous gift; Jianyan's son Wuyuan inherited the title and ended as Chief Administrator of the household of the Prince of Bin.
proposals.reason: Bin King's Household is unnatural for 邠王府; 復贈 is a posthumous restoration.

proposals.before: In time he was made vice minister of revenue with charge of treasury affairs, then transferred to grand mentor of the heir apparent.
proposals.after: In time he was made vice minister of revenue with charge of treasury affairs, then transferred to chief administrator of the household of the heir apparent.
proposals.reason: 太子詹事 is the crown prince's household director, not Grand Mentor.

proposals.before: After a long time he was transferred to Vice Minister of the Households and judged the treasury; he was then changed to Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent.
proposals.after: After a long time he was transferred to Vice Minister of Revenue and judged the treasury; he was then changed to Chief Administrator of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
proposals.reason: 戶部 is Revenue, not Households; 詹事 is not Grand Mentor.

proposals.before: The emperor again asked which brothers of senior ministers might serve. His attendants named Wang Shaozhi's elder brother Shu and Han Gao's elder brother Qun.
proposals.after: The emperor again asked which brothers of senior ministers might serve. His attendants named Wang Shao's elder brother Shu and Han Gao's elder brother Qun.
proposals.reason: 王紹 is Wang Shao; the extra zhi is not in the Chinese.

proposals.before: He again asked which brothers of great ministers were fit for employment; those beside him answered with Wang Shaozhi's elder brother Shu and Han Gao's elder brother Qun.
proposals.after: He again asked which brothers of great ministers were fit for employment; those beside him answered with Wang Shao's elder brother Shu and Han Gao's elder brother Qun.
proposals.reason: 王紹 should be Wang Shao, not Wang Shaozhi.

proposals.before: Early in the Wude era he was promoted to grand master of splendid happiness with the golden seal and placed in charge of the directorate of gardens and parks.
proposals.after: Early in the Wude era he was promoted to Senior Commander Unequalled in Honor and placed in charge of the Directorate of Gardens and Parks.
proposals.reason: 上開府儀同三司 is the kaifu yitong sansi prestige title, not the golden-seal grand-mastership.

proposals.before: Early in Wude he was advanced to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal and judged the Directorate of Gardens and Parks.
proposals.after: Early in Wude he was advanced to Senior Commander Unequalled in Honor and placed in concurrent charge of the Directorate of Gardens and Parks.
proposals.reason: The Chinese is 上開府儀同三司; 判 marks concurrent charge, not a golden-seal office.

proposals.before: At Zhoushi, Sizhu, and the valley mouths of Lantian, bandits gather in bands.
proposals.after: At Zhouzhi, Sizhu, and the valley mouths of Lantian, bandits gather in bands.
proposals.reason: 盩厔 is the county Zhouzhi, not Zhoushi.

proposals.before: At Zhoushi, Sizhu, and the valley mouths of Lantian, bandits gather in groups.
proposals.after: At Zhouzhi, Sizhu, and the valley mouths of Lantian, bandits gather in groups.
proposals.reason: 盩厔 should be romanized Zhouzhi.

proposals.before: Soon an envoy from the censorate arrived at his door. His sons rushed to tell him, but Fuga rose slowly to receive the messenger.
proposals.after: Soon an envoy from the censorate arrived at his door. His sons and younger brothers rushed to tell him, but Fuga rose slowly to receive the messenger.
proposals.reason: Chinese 子弟 is sons and younger brothers, which the literal already has; the idiomatic dropped the younger brothers.

proposals.before: In the fourth year of Zhenguan, an edict ordered conscripts to repair the Qianyang Hall of the Luoyang palace and also to travel east on campaign.
proposals.after: In the fourth year of Zhenguan, an edict ordered conscripts to repair the Qianyang Hall of the Luoyang palace and also to make an eastern imperial visit.
proposals.reason: 東幸 is an imperial progress or visit, not a military campaign.

proposals.before: Your Majesty has only begun to transform a broken society—how can you tour east and unsettle the people's hearts? Fifth, this cannot be done.
proposals.after: Your Majesty has only begun to transform a broken society—how can you tour east and unsettle the people's hearts?
proposals.reason: The clause 五不可也 belongs to the next sentence s0239; the idiomatic imported it here.

proposals.before: He served as junior grand mentor of the heir, then was made right vice director of the heir apparent's household.
proposals.after: He served as junior supervisor of the heir apparent's household, then was transferred to right vice director of the heir apparent's household.
proposals.reason: 太子少詹事 is the junior zhanshi of the heir's household, not the grand-mentor (太傅) office.

proposals.before: He served successively as Junior Grand Mentor of the Heir and was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Household.
proposals.after: He served successively as Junior Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent and was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Heir Apparent's Household.
proposals.reason: Same office error: 少詹事 is not Junior Grand Mentor.

proposals.before: The Duke of Zhou was endowed with sagehood, yet he attended others in the bath and shared his meal with humble scholars from thatched cottages—how much more should you, who stand below the Duke of Zhou?
proposals.after: The Duke of Zhou was endowed with sagehood, yet he would pause mid-wash and spit out his food to receive guests, and he went down to men in thatched cottages—how much more should those below the Duke of Zhou do so?
proposals.reason: 握沐吐飧 is the 吐哺握发 topos (stopping bath and meal to receive worthies), not attending others in the bath.

proposals.before: Soon he was recalled and appointed governor of Chaozhou, then transferred to Dengzhou, and never again allowed near the heir.
proposals.after: Soon he was recalled and appointed governor of Chaozhou, then transferred to Dengzhou, and to the end was never again kept in close confidence.
proposals.reason: 訖不復親近 does not name the heir; it means he was never again taken into intimacy.

decisions.reason: 祖彤 served in a single Northern Wei office, 通直散騎常侍; the original English invents a palace-library directorship and splits one cavalier-attendant title into two posts.
The Chinese speech 卿自謂佞邪，直邪？ is fully closed in this unit, so the literal English quotation needs the missing closing mark.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 調之曰：「卿自謂佞邪，直邪？」

decisions.reason: The emperor’s question 今日畋，樂乎？ is closed in this unit; the literal English must close the matching quotation.
The Chinese quotation opened here continues into the next unit and is not closed in s0042; adding a closing mark would wrongly end the speech before 何雕麗底此.
This unit completes the speech begun in s0042 and closes it with 」; the literal English must supply the corresponding closing quotation mark.
In this marketplace flogging, 五伯 are the lictors who actually whip him, not ward chiefs; the rest of the proposed sentence preserves the original wording.
Liangsi’s speech is fully closed in this unit with 」; the literal English quotation is missing that close.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 未聞天子賣果蔬與人爭利。」

decisions.reason: Empress Wu’s warning is closed in this unit; the literal English quotation needs the missing closing mark.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 戒曰：「第出入北門，彼南衙宰相行來，毋犯之。」

decisions.after: An edict directed all officials to attend his funeral rites. He was posthumously honored as commander unequalled in honor and as regional commander of Yizhou.
decisions.reason: The original title 金紫光祿大夫 is wrong for 開府儀同三司, but the proposed romanization-plus-parenthesis is awkward in otherwise idiomatic English; render the prestige title in English.

decisions.reason: 復贈 is a restored posthumous grant of 司空, and 邠王府 is the household of the Prince of Bin, not a 'Bin King.'

sourceWitness.excerpt: 復贈司空……終邠王府長史

decisions.reason: 改太子詹事 is transfer to the heir apparent’s household directorate, not the grand-mentor (太傅) office.
戶部侍郎 is vice minister of revenue, not of 'Households,' and 太子詹事 is not Grand Mentor.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遷戶部侍郎，判度支，改太子詹事

decisions.reason: 王紹之兄紓 names Wang Shao and then his elder brother Shu; the extra syllable in Shaozhi is a misreading of 之.
The same 王紹之兄 construction must be Wang Shao, not Wang Shaozhi, in the literal field as well.
武德初 he was advanced to 上開府儀同三司, a prestige title, not 金紫光祿大夫; 判農圃監 is concurrent charge of the gardens directorate.

decisions.reason: The literal must match 上開府儀同三司, and 判 marks concurrent charge of 農圃監 rather than a golden-seal office or a verdict.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 上開府儀同三司，判農圃監

decisions.reason: 盩厔 is the Guanzhong county Zhouzhi; Zhoushi is a false romanization.
The same place name 盩厔 should be Zhouzhi in the literal romanization.
子弟 are sons and younger brothers; the idiomatic dropped the junior kinsmen who brought the news.

decisions.after: In the fourth year of Zhenguan, an edict ordered conscripts to repair the Qianyang Hall of the Luoyang palace and also planned an eastern imperial visit.
decisions.reason: 東幸 is an imperial progress, not a campaign, but the proposed wording still makes the conscripts the visitors; the edict orders the repairs and plans the emperor’s eastern visit.

decisions.reason: s0238 ends at 詎可東巡以搖人心？; 五不可也 is the next sentence and must not be imported here.
太子少詹事 is the junior director of the heir’s household, not junior grand mentor; 遷右庶子 is the following transfer.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 曆太子少詹事，遷右庶子

decisions.reason: The same 少詹事 error appears in the literal field and is correctly replaced as junior supervisor of the heir apparent’s household.

握沐吐飧 is the topos of interrupting wash and meal to receive worthies, and 下白屋 is condescending to men in humble cottages; the original bath-attendance reading is false, and 下周公之人 is generic, not a direct 'you.'

sourceWitness.excerpt: 握沐吐飧，下白屋，況下周公之人哉？

decisions.reason: 訖不復親近 says he was never again kept in intimacy; it does not name the heir, whom the original English invents.

claimRevisions.reason: The extracted English name Wang Shaozhi was produced by reading 之 in 王紹之兄紓 as part of the personal name; the source names Wang Shao.
